rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Who We Used to Be
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our driving song! First lift since the divorce. Shall I be your reckless navigator again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just get me to the station. No scenic detours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sensible route. Wonderful. Shall we stop for sensible sandwiches? You used to kiss me quiet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes. Just find my ticket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here it is. Platform two! Run, my handsome fugitive! That got you laughing all through our honeymoon.

card.title: Who We Used to Be
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wore the scarf from our first photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't fit your coat anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It fits the person you met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to be that person.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until dessert. He knew how to make you laugh.

card.title: Love Means Checking
card.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Text when you and Ben reach the cinema, love, so I know you're safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum, my phone stays off during the film.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When does it finish? I'll wait up for your message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're walking to dinner afterwards. We haven't chosen anywhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive behind you while you choose. You can keep your phone off; I'll see for myself that you're having a nice time.

card.title: Love Means Checking
card.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your train snacks. Send me a photo of the departure board so I know you're all right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone's nearly dead. I've written down the platform.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which platform? I'll watch the departures here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Platform six. Can you bring a charger instead?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll stay until you're charged enough to send updates all the way.

transfer.action: I put our old song on softly beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I remember who we were when this played. {request}
transfer.response: Let's try the old route once before listing the changes. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then we can walk beside them for the length of one song.

transfer.action: I put my checklist of your day beside {prop}.
transfer.response: I've already prepared what you might need. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You don't need to know every detail.
transfer.closing: Then give me enough detail to stop imagining the missing ones.
